note: At the south end of Waterton townsite beside Upper Waterton Lake, a large, mostly open campground. The 110 full-hookup sites (loops A and B) are drive-through; the 75 electric-only sites (C, D, G; 15/30 amp) are back-in, and loops D and G face the lake across Waterton Avenue. Loops E and H are tents only. No fire pits at the sites: wood fires only in the shared kitchen shelters. The full-hookup B loop closes in late September. Outside the operating season, electric and unserviced sites stay open first-come by self-registration with no washrooms, but the campground is not cleared of snow. --Claude
